title: 可数与不可数

examples.en: I need a piece of paper.
She bought two bottles of milk.

guess.question: 为什么不说 two papers、two milks？

options.text: paper、milk 是不可数名词，没有复数，要借“张、瓶”这样的单位来表达数量
options.feedback: 对！不可数名词不能加 -s，也不能直接加数词，数量靠单位词来说。
不对——多少跟能不能加 s 无关，牛奶再多也不能说 milks。
不对——这里说的是“两张、两瓶”，数量并不止一个。

rule.rule: 不可数名词没有复数，也不能直接加 a/an 或数字；要表示数量用“单位词 + of”
rule.formula: a piece of paper / two bottles of milk / a cup of tea / three pieces of news

anchors.en: I need a piece of paper.
anchors.note: paper 不可数，用 piece 计量

anchors.en: She bought two bottles of milk.
anchors.note: 两瓶 → bottles 变复数，milk 不变

trap.wrong: I have two good news to tell you.
trap.right: I have two pieces of good news to tell you.
trap.why: news 是不可数名词，计量要说 two pieces of。

guess_callback: 你刚才选的是 A——不可数名词要借“张、瓶、杯、条”来数：a piece of / a bottle of / a cup of。

check.stem: — Can I help you? — Yes, I'd like two ____ of bread.

options.distractor: two 后面单位词要变复数

check.explanation: 两片面包：two pieces of bread（pieces 变复数，bread 不变）。

check.stem: My mother bought three ____ of milk yesterday.

options.distractor: three 后面单位词要变复数

check.explanation: 三瓶牛奶：three bottles of milk。

options.text: Here is a piece of good news.

options.distractor: news 不可数，不能加 a
要说 two pieces of good news

check.explanation: news 不可数：一条消息 = a piece of news。
